Charles E. Harris & Associates was founded in 1986 with the commitment to provide outstanding auditing, accounting and consulting services to our clients. Our all-encompassing objective is to give you the best services for your tax dollar while making your audit as pain-free as possible. Over the past 30 years, our clients have commended our unparalleled professionalism and efficiency. We're confident that you'll have the same experience.
